failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Some of the SONIC PTF testcases failed due to missing 'scopepro' binary. Issue is specific to usage of Transcend SSD.

Error Observed:

"2025 Mar 18 <IPV6>.058808 str-marvell-tl10-01 ERR pmon#StorageCommon[31]: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'scopepro'"

Test Cases Impacted in our run of PTF:
test_everflow_dscp_with_policer
test_cacl_tc3_acl_all
test_eth_interface_admin_change
test_start_pfcwd
test_gnoi_killprocess_then_restart
test_restart_bmp_docker

### Steps to Reproduce

Issue is reproducible with platforms using Transcend SSD. Test failures can be seen in SONIC PTF run.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

scopepro is used for getting Transcend SSD parameters. Expected behavior will be to fetch all the needed information about SSD using scopepro.

resolution.title: Use smartctl for Transcend SSD
resolution.description:
Use 'smartctl' Transcend SSD instead of 'scopepro'. Scopepro utility is not present in debian repository and all functionality of scopepro can also be supported using generic smartctl.

#### Description
Change uses 'smartctl' and its generic implementation for reading SSD parameter for Transcend SSD.
Change also removes the references of 'scopepro'.
Update the test_ssd to also use 'smartctl' output for  Transcend SSD.

#### Motivation and Context
fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22163

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Tested in platform using Transcend SSD with full SONIC PTF run. Test where run with 'sonic-marvell-teralynx.bin'.

#### Additional Information (Optional)
Backport of fix is needed in following sonic-platform-common branches

- [x] 202411
